Ashoka Fellows · Organizations
Nearby markers are grouped into clickable numbered clusters. Select a cluster to browse every NGO inside. District-level demographics are shown where available; otherwise separately labelled comparison data is provided when possible.
Records with no identifiable Indian locality remain searchable but are not placed arbitrarily. For missing district data, nearby comparison districts are clearly labelled as proxies—not the NGO district’s demographics.
Map colors and district composition use your provided dataset wherever available. Census 2011 is used only when your district composition is unavailable. Only unambiguous, validated CSV-to-boundary matches are colored. Grey means unavailable, ambiguous, missing, or geographically incompatible data. Categories from the CSV mix caste/social and religion groups, so do not interpret the largest label as a mutually exclusive population majority. State summaries count district leaders, not population shares.
